scope: Unresolved implementation dependencies, optional opportunities and alternatives preserved by the critic-final proposal. Leads record uncertainty and proposed evidence; they are not claims of observed product behavior.

unresolved.topic: DuckDB v1.5.6 CSV issue #25164 behavior in shipped artifacts
unresolved.status: open; critical before enabling affected CSV inputs
unresolved.known: Issue #25164 reports duplicate rows with parallel CRCRLF scans. PR #25232 merged a scanner guard and regression test on v2.0-cyanoptera. The exact v1.5.6 scanner source lacks that hunk at the inspected path and the exact test path returns 404. The proposed main port remains unmerged in the 2026-10-06 capture. The upstream test source requires notwindows.
unresolved.unknown: No exact v1.5.6 Python wheel, CLI or platform artifact was executed. Source absence and test-path 404 do not prove the binary behavior or exclude another implementation/fix. Other CRCRLF parser issues are outside the one regression shape.
unresolved.next_evidence: Run the issue reproduction and expanded boundary, quoted-newline and tail matrix against each exact distributed artifact and supported platform; record artifact/source build hashes, row counts, identities, reject behavior and architecture. Add a separate Windows test or disable the affected support there.
unresolved.proposal_effect: Keep the streaming CRCRLF preflight rejection until the exact artifact/platform gate passes. If it fails or cannot be verified, defer that file or use a separately qualified reader.

unresolved.status: open; critical for clean replay and cross-machine use
unresolved.known: nbformat 5.10.4 and nbclient 0.10.2 are exact starting pins. DuckDB 1.5.6 is an engine source candidate. Jupyter Client protocol documentation capture identifies 8.10.0.
unresolved.unknown: No compatible exact Python minor, jupyter_client, ipykernel, pyzmq, traitlets, DuckDB binding, extensions and transitive artifact hashes were resolved or run together; no immutable runner image digest exists.
unresolved.next_evidence: Build and hash one complete lock/image, then execute strict clean replay twice and verify matching package/image and output association.
unresolved.proposal_effect: The pins are planning inputs only. Block clean replay when a receiving machine cannot obtain the exact locked runtime; preserve saved output as historical/unverified.

unresolved.topic: Linux sandbox policy, Jupyter transport and resource enforcement
unresolved.status: open; critical before running untrusted notebooks or SQL
unresolved.known: Bubblewrap constructs mount and namespace layouts but leaves policy to the caller. Jupyter Client 8.10.0 documents local TCP kernel sockets unencrypted by default. Bubblewrap alone supplies no cgroup CPU/memory or disk quota.
unresolved.unknown: Exact invocation, host-visible control path, user-namespace policy, seccomp profile, cgroup/resource-controller support, kernel-port containment, process cleanup and platform usability are untested.
unresolved.next_evidence: Review the exact policy with security engineering; test namespace mounts/network isolation, a private manager/client/kernel transport, cgroup cleanup, quotas, cancellation and fail-closed behavior on each supported Linux distribution.
unresolved.proposal_effect: Limit execution to systems where the full reviewed policy and aggregate limits can be enforced. Keep other platforms edit/open/export-only until a reviewed adapter exists.

unresolved.topic: 5 GB behavior on the 8-core/16 GB workstation
unresolved.known: DuckDB describes streaming and operator-specific spill mechanisms, with workload and temp-disk trade-offs.
unresolved.unknown: Peak RSS, spill bytes, wall time, correctness, cancellation and failure behavior for the exact build and operation classes are unmeasured.
unresolved.next_evidence: Generate representative 5 GB data and measure filter/projection, low/high-cardinality aggregation, sort, join, distinct, window and Python materialization with memory and temp quotas.
unresolved.proposal_effect: Advertise only measured operation classes. Resource exhaustion is a visible failed run; no universal 5 GB support claim.

unresolved.topic: Mutable external source identity and cache correctness
unresolved.known: The proposal uses complete content digests and dependency keys; direct path references avoid an unnecessary import copy. Engine readers operate on files and can scan only selected columns/rows for some requests.
unresolved.unknown: No adapter proves a pre-run path hash represents the exact bytes consumed while a concurrently mutable file is read. Snapshot storage/time costs and verified stable-reader options are unmeasured.
unresolved.next_evidence: Test immutable content-addressed snapshots, full-stream hashing, concurrent source mutation and cache invalidation. Verify that the bytes whose digest enters a run key are the bytes actually consumed.
unresolved.proposal_effect: Keep direct external paths as the no-copy registration default, but require immutable or otherwise verified stable bytes to label a clean output current; otherwise show input stability unverified.

unresolved.topic: Transactional save, locking and recovery across local filesystems
unresolved.status: open; critical for durable output associations
unresolved.known: The proposal defines a manifest pointer as commit point, immutable output blobs and an append-only event log with prepare/commit reconciliation.
unresolved.unknown: Atomic rename, directory sync, fsync durability, lock behavior, stale-lock recovery and crash ordering vary by platform/filesystem and have not been tested.
unresolved.next_evidence: Crash-inject every write/sync/rename boundary on the supported local filesystems; test a second opener, stale writer lock, partial log and folder/zip recovery.
unresolved.proposal_effect: Support only validated local filesystem combinations initially; other filesystems remain outside the save/concurrency guarantee.

unresolved.topic: Format adapters, schema evolution and row identity
unresolved.status: open; critical before declaring format subsets supported
unresolved.known: DuckDB docs expose inference, explicit parser settings, faulty-line inspection, JSON configuration and Parquet schema reads.
unresolved.unknown: Pinned-engine behavior for missing versus null, heterogeneous JSON, invalid UTF-8, duplicate names, nested Parquet, schema drift, timestamp offsets, reject byte spans and stable record ordinals is untested.
unresolved.next_evidence: Run fixtures for all listed cases against the exact engine artifact; verify every input record is preserved in accepted rows or explicit reject objects, and source digests remain unchanged.
unresolved.proposal_effect: Support only a validated typed subset; strict failure or user-reviewed reject sidecar for unsupported/malformed inputs; no silent migration or row loss.

unresolved.topic: Notebook output dependency and status model
unresolved.status: open; critical for user-visible reproducibility claims
unresolved.known: Notebook files store outputs/counts; nbclient can skip tags, permit tagged errors unless forced strict, and update earlier outputs by display_id; protocol parent headers support event correlation.
unresolved.unknown: No event implementation has been validated for out-of-order runs, cross-cell display updates, kernel restart, interrupted replay or missing message associations.
unresolved.next_evidence: Build a tiny real notebook runtime case matrix for strict tags/errors, interactive order, display_id updates, restart, cancellation, output commit and reopen status.
unresolved.proposal_effect: Configure strict replay explicitly, keep interactive output unverified, link display updates to affected outputs, and preserve attempt status separately from last-good output provenance.

optional_opportunities.idea: Schema drift review before promoting a new source version
optional_opportunities.value: Compare approved contract with new full-scan schema, sampled values, missing/added fields, lossy casts and quarantined records before dependent work reruns.
optional_opportunities.status: useful product opportunity; proposed, not implemented

optional_opportunities.value: Group a result change by notebook/cell source, data snapshot/contract, environment/engine and output artifact, then expose a key-based row diff only when identity is defined.
optional_opportunities.status: derived from the brief; accessibility and analyst usability need evaluation

optional_opportunities.value: Bundle the small manifest, run events and selected output/input objects with hashes; let users choose explicitly whether large or private data is included.
optional_opportunities.status: follow-up opportunity; no DVC or external lineage compatibility claim is made

alternatives_to_keep_visible.option: Use JupyterLab/Notebook as the complete front end and add a local provenance manager.
alternatives_to_keep_visible.tradeoff: Reduces editor work; current/stale state, output association, transactional artifacts, source snapshots and sandbox policy still require integration and validation.

alternatives_to_keep_visible.option: Use a separately qualified CSV reader or a DuckDB artifact that passes the exact regression gate.
alternatives_to_keep_visible.tradeoff: May allow a broader CSV subset; its parser schema/error behavior and every shipped artifact need independent verification. The v2.0-branch fix alone is not a stable release guarantee.

alternatives_to_keep_visible.option: Use a local VM adapter for execution on macOS/Windows or where Linux namespaces/resource control are unavailable.
alternatives_to_keep_visible.tradeoff: Can provide a clearer image and file boundary; adds startup, disk, mount and interactive-kernel costs. No VM backend is selected or tested here.

alternatives_to_keep_visible.option: Use an Arrow/Polars-first data stack instead of DuckDB.
alternatives_to_keep_visible.tradeoff: Could change memory, schema and CSV behavior; SQL fit, streaming/spill, type semantics and issue history must be independently sourced and benchmarked before selection.
